recommendations.text: Assess glycaemic status at initial evaluation in all patients with ACS.
recommendations.population: All patients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS)

recommendations.text: Frequently monitor blood glucose levels in patients with known diabetes mellitus or hyperglycaemia.
recommendations.population: Patients with known diabetes mellitus or hyperglycaemia

recommendations.text: Apply the same diagnostic and treatment strategies in older patients as in younger patients.
recommendations.notes: Recommendation to use same strategies as for younger patients.
